old: The Repair (Leucine/L-Serine): L-Serine acts as a precursor to D-Serine to recalibrate the GluD 'Volume Dial' to enhance therapeutic sessions that end with low fear/high mastery (although conversion to D-serine is inefficient, which is why some people use D-serine itself which has higher risk/benefit). Leucine facilitates structural repair while simultaneously tuning synaptic gain to reduce the 'itchy brain' sensation
new: The Repair (Leucine/L-Serine): L-Serine is what the brain makes D-Serine from, so it can help recalibrate the GluD "Volume Dial" and make therapy sessions that end with low fear and a sense of mastery stick better. The conversion isn't very efficient though, so some people take D-serine itself instead (more risk, but also more benefit). And we use Leucine for structural repair, since it also tunes synaptic gain, which eases the "itchy brain" feeling.
